messages.subject: cleaned up error_handling
parts:
I took a pass through math/error_handling. To wit, I

1. eliminated the vector versions of policy inference; the templates
version for scalars also match vectors, so we don't need the vector
versions.

2. simplified the bodies of the main function to coax g++
into inlining, a side effect of which is moving lots of cut-and-paste code
for marshaling domain errors into one place.

There are a handful of cases that need to be vectorized and
I'll do those tonight.

The argument for (2) isn't nearly as strong now that I pulled
the tests out of the inner loop in normal.hpp.

Every day is Spring Cleaning here on the Stan Ranch.

- Bob
